entities.name: Physical Layer Problem Recovery
entities.description: Procedure triggered when UE receives N311 consecutive in-sync indications for SpCell while T310 is running. The UE stops timers and maintains RRC connection without explicit signaling.

entities.name: Timer T310
entities.description: Timer running for SpCell physical layer problem detection.

entities.name: Timer T312
entities.description: Timer that may be running for SpCell physical layer problem detection.

entities.name: N311 consecutive in-sync indications
entities.description: Condition where UE receives N311 consecutive in-sync indications from lower layers for SpCell while T310 is running.

entities.name: Maintain RRC connection
entities.description: UE maintains RRC connection without explicit signaling and preserves entire radio resource configuration.

relations.description: Procedure is triggered by receiving N311 consecutive in-sync indications while T310 is running
Procedure stops timer T310 for the corresponding SpCell
Procedure stops timer T312 for the corresponding SpCell if running
Procedure results in maintaining RRC connection without explicit signaling
